# LunaWake

> LunaWake is a bedside sleep device paired with an AI sleep coach. Nothing to wear: the device looks after wind-down and wake-up with its own light and sound, and the Luna App reads your nights and helps you keep a rhythm that fits your life. Slogan: Your sleep, in rhythm.

Two things LunaWake does:
1. The Bedroom Autopilot: a gentle bedtime chime timed to your rhythm, built-in soundscapes designed to fade out after you fall asleep, a soft floor glow when you get up at night, and a wake-up with light and sound. Most of it is on by default and can be turned off in the app.
2. AI Sleep Coach: each morning starts with a short written summary of last night instead of a score. Sleep score, stages, and trends are available as supporting detail. Ask Luna answers from the user's own record, habits, and daily life.

Signature feature — Rhythm check: hold the device for two seconds and it says roughly where your body is in its daily rhythm (for example the afternoon dip or the sleep window) with one suggestion. The app shows the whole day's rhythm as a strip. The spoken suggestion is only given on the device.

Key facts:
- Wearable-free: no ring, no watch. Contact-free radar at the bedside senses presence, movement, and breathing.
- No camera. Microphones measure room loudness and capture clips of a few seconds when a snore-like sound occurs, for snore detection only. No speech recognition and no voice assistant.
- Physical privacy switch: when flipped, radar and microphones stop sensing and the app cannot turn them back on. Light, sound, Wind Down, and alarms keep working.
- Data: radar signals are processed on the device. After each night the sleep record is encrypted and uploaded to create sleep stages, the morning summary, and trends. Data is not sold, not used for advertising, and not used to train AI models. Export and deletion are available by emailing support@lunawake.ai.
- Smart Wake: a soft glow ten minutes before the alarm; the alarm starts at the time the user sets. It does not pick a wake time from sleep stages or movement.
- Offline: after a one-time Wi-Fi setup, alarms, light, sound, and overnight recording keep running on the device without a connection. Sleep reports, Luna, and updates need a connection. The device has no battery; after a power cut it needs to reconnect to recover the time.
- One object in place of three: sound machine, sunrise alarm, and wearable-free sleep tracker, plus an AI sleep coach.
- Pricing: one-time hardware purchase, no subscription and no monthly or annual fee. Device features and sleep data stay free. Asking Luna and periodic reports use credits, bought as needed and never expiring; some come with the device. Prices are not announced.
- Designed for one sleeper closest to the device; reliable multi-person separation is not a supported capability.
- Testing: contact-free sensing is being compared against technician-scored polysomnography (PSG) in a university sleep lab. This work is in progress and no accuracy figure is claimed.
- Category: consumer wellness product. Not a medical device; not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent disease. Luna's coaching draws on CBT-I methods and does not diagnose.
- Status: pre-launch. Launch list at https://reserve.hellolunawake.com/

## The Luna App

- Luna is the app's single conversational agent, reached through Ask Luna. Answers are grounded in the user's own sleep record and the habits they have shared.
- Each morning: a short summary of last night. A Daily Brief covers the whole sleep day. Neither assigns tasks or routines.
- Sleep Pattern: a long-term picture of how a person sleeps, with charts and a written reading, updated as the record changes.
- The app can work from Apple Health sleep data without the device. Each night uses one data source.
- Lunawake MCP lets a user connect their sleep data, read-only and with their authorization, to an AI agent they already use.
